name: Navigate to a place
description: Drive the holonomic base to a free stand-off pose next to a room, piece of furniture, support, articulated part or object. The arm is tucked when empty, or held in the compact carry pose with the load.

destination.description: Where to go: a room, furniture, support, articulated part or object.

base_pose.description: Measured base pose [x, y, yaw_deg] at arrival.

verifier.name: base_near
verifier.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

paths.note: An object held by both grippers moves at the slow bimanual carry speed.
Back off, lift the load to carry height, plan with extra clearance, drive slowly.

relations.when: a manipulation target is on the destination
relations.reason: navigate leaves the base near; approach makes the target IK-reachable.

relations.when: the destination must be observed first
navigation fails because the base or load is wedged against furniture
relations.reason: Backing out frees the planner's start cell, then navigate again.

relations.when: navigation fails because the empty arm cannot fold
relations.reason: A separately planned fold clears the arm before the base path.

relations.when: a carried object hangs too low for the doorway clearance
relations.reason: Raising the load restores the carry clearance.

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop

includes: stand-off pose search around the noun's footprint
excludes: arm reachability of a specific target
